selection_rule: From the first 12 sorted public train instructions: first all-target scenario and first cross-app set reconciliation scenario; take _1 only. No solution, metadata, evaluator or model outcome used.
server_lease_basis: Existing supervisor was launched with --max-seconds 14400; reserve 180 seconds beyond both runs. Do not begin if this lease is too short.
scope: Two already observed development tasks, one seed each. Standard assistant/tool history, not a novel method or causal quality claim.
discovery_policy: Initially api_docs and supervisor schemas. A requested app description exposes that public app; individual API documentation exposes that API. New schemas apply on the next model response. No answer-based selection or silent top-k pruning.
interpretation: API schemas, discovery, dispatch, model, task order and budgets remain matched to P8.
This is baseline interface calibration. Role placement, rendering, paging and cache reuse can differ; no one-component causal claim.
Errors and usage-unknown calls remain counted. Final evaluator is offline and never feeds later generation.
After this finite calibration, freeze the viable interface and examine memory failures on task variation; do not add baseline changes indefinitely.
history_representation: Append-only public assistant content/calls and tool observations; no reasoning replay. Same archive page size. Invalid argument turns use text fallback preserving raw calls and actual results.
changes_from_P8: Task moves to the initial user turn; normal proposals and tool receipts keep assistant/tool roles and call IDs.
Archive IDs are available in the corresponding receipts; read_span is unchanged.
Long receipts use the same original span page; previous model-generated content/calls remain in the assistant turn.
Malformed or non-object argument batches remain assistant text with actual recorded observations as user text; never repair, drop, retry or dispatch them again.
